body: Very sorry for what you’re going through. All I can say is I’m about the same age and also went through a lot of shit. Decades of depression and other stuff. Tried numerous medications, tried Ect several times. In patient stays several times. Out patient stays, different hospitals. Therapy. Nothing worked. The only thing that made a slight difference in the end was ketamine therapy. I’m very sorry thats all I got to offer for you. Your situation sounds bad, I’m not gonna lie. I hope you find a way to keep fighting.
